title: test(research): audit V45 native residual and private endpoint
body:
## Summary

Take PR2993's native-residual/private-endpoint handoff for PR2979 helper249, source head `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576`.

```text
authenticate two final words and retained native tools
check six literal helper climbs and the rank7 residual on all512 columns
pull back endpoint rows249/953 through all17575 gates in both orientations
```

Both providers have exact formal endpoint rows `e249` and `e953`. Seven serialized native recipes include global phase; the wrapped ZERO-to-W residual is exactly F7. The package adds a separate reverse-covector implementation and explicit source pins. It complements PR2993's frame audit and PR2987's owner audit.

## Evidence

- **Before:** deleting cleanup gate72 leaves private953's original-input response zero in forward execution, but creates inverse-transpose coefficient `-1/2` from original input11. This is a deliberate verifier control, not a source defect.
  **After:** the unchanged source words pass both endpoint orientations. All seven native recipes pass the independent512-column kernel, and global-phase/input-character mutants fail.
- Registered CPython3.12.15 replay and eight behavioral groups pass. Optimized CPython3.14.8 replay, warnings-as-errors compilation, Ruff and a separate internal read-only review pass. Hosted CI is separate.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-v45-native-endpoint`. See the package README, RESULT.json and TASK.json for exact scope, controls, source heads and open questions.
- Scientific base and refreshed canonical main: `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11`, priority revision6. Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18978346.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

New opt-in research package only. No frozen inputs, shared code, selected frontier or existing PR dispositions change. Native helper identities and normalized endpoint covectors are separate finite results; full emitted event/warp bindings, every output row, physical storage/precision, outer release and all-size admission remain unchecked. No new supplier or kappa is claimed.

Credit Marius-Paul Dumitrean, Jeremy Kothe, Mason Hale, Jeremy Diviney, icekylinx, Sagar Thakrar, Ross Richardson and the retained lineage in the README. Substantial automated assistance in analysis, implementation, internal review and writing; no independent human or formal-kernel review claimed.
